load_ground_truth_actions: load ground truth commands and their logical form parses from dataset files into a dictionary
parse_ground_truth_datasets: parse pipe-delimited dataset files mapping natural language text to JSON logical forms
walk_ground_truth_directory: walk a ground truth data directory and load all dataset files into a command-to-parse mapping
review_get_ground_truth: review the get_ground_truth function that loads ground truth actions from a directory of pipe-delimited files
test_get_ground_truth: test the get_ground_truth function with a sample data directory and verify the returned dictionary
